declarations.description:
A searchable grid of emoji in categories, with a skin-tone choice and the emoji used last, like the pickers of Slack,
GitHub and Discord. Picking an emoji fires `emoji-select`; the picker does not close or insert anything itself, so it
fits a popover, a reaction bar (`c2-reaction-bar` takes one in its `picker` slot) or a panel of its own.

The default set is every Unicode emoji up to 15.1 with English names and search keywords, from Emojibase. Set `emojis`
to offer your own set: a localised one, a smaller one, or custom emoji whose `emoji` is any text. Searching matches
the start of any word of a name or its keywords.

The emoji are one grid in reading order: the arrow keys move between them (up and down by visual row), Home and End
go to the first and last, Enter or Space picks one. From the search field, Arrow Down enters the grid and Enter picks
the first match. The category buttons scroll to their section.

Recently used emoji are listed first. They and the skin tone persist across visits only under a `storage-key`, kept
in `localStorage`; without one they last as long as the element.

members.name: emojis
members.description: The emoji offered. Defaults to every Unicode emoji up to 15.1, with English names, from Emojibase.

members.name: skinTone
members.description: The skin tone applied to emoji that have one: 0 is the default yellow, 1 to 5 run from light to dark.

members.name: recents
members.description: The recently used emoji, newest first, without skin tones. Picking one moves it to the front.

members.name: maxRecents
members.description: How many recently used emoji are kept. 0 hides the section.

members.name: storageKey
members.description: `localStorage` key the recently used emoji and the skin tone are kept under. Without it they are not stored.

members.name: query
members.description: Text in the search field. Setting it searches.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the picker. Defaults to "Emoji picker" in the page's language.

members.name: activeIndex
members.description: Index, in display order, of the emoji that takes focus in the grid. Kept off the render: moving it re-renders nothing.

members.name: previewed
members.description: The emoji the preview names: the one pointed at, else the one focused.

members.name: flat
members.description: The emoji listed, in display order: what the arrow keys walk through.

members.name: loadedKey
members.description: The `storage-key` whose entry has been read.

members.name: sectionCache
members.description: The sections last computed, and what they were computed from.

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus to the search field.

members.name: shown
members.description: The emoji as shown: in the chosen skin tone when it has one.

members.name: renderSections
members.description: The grid of every section. Guarded in `render`: pointing at or focusing an emoji re-renders only the preview.

members.name: setTabStop
members.description: Moves the grid's single tab stop to `index`, touching only the old and the new stop.

members.name: verticalNeighbour
members.description: The emoji in the next visual row up or down, nearest in x: rows differ in length between sections.

members.name: handleTonesFocusOut
members.description: The choice of tones closes when focus leaves it for anything but the button that opened it.

events.name: emoji-select
events.description: An emoji was picked. `detail.emoji` carries the chosen skin tone; `detail.base` is the emoji without one. Bubbles.

events.name: skin-tone-change
events.description: The reader chose another skin tone.
